title: Demographic Biases and Gaps in the Perception of Sexism in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Inducing explicit male and female demographic personas in LLMs via prompting, and measuring the Pearson correlation between the models' soft predictions for sexism and the actual human annotations from the corresponding gender groups.

Inducing age-specific personas (e.g., 18-22, 23-45, 46+) in LLMs via prompting, and measuring the Pearson correlation between the models' predictions for sexism and the human annotations from those specific age demographics.

Assigning compound demographic personas that include specific countries (e.g., Italy, Mexico, Canada, Spain, Germany) via prompting to evaluate how geographic context influences the models' ability to align with human perceptions of sexism.
